# Sam Altman

###### Co-Founder and CEO, OpenAI

**Sam Altman** is the co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the research and deployment company behind ChatGPT and DALL·E. The firm was started in 2015 as a nonprofit research lab with the mission to build general-purpose artificial intelligence benefitting all humanity. Previously, he was president of the early stage startup accelerator Y Combinator from 2014 to 2019. Altman’s recognition includes being named Time’s 2023 CEO of the year.

Sam Altman: Silicon Valley leader, Elon Musk rival, and bona fide gearhead.

On Sunday, a TikToker posted a video showing a large block of sports and exotic cars — from Ford Mustangs and an Acura NSX to a Pagani Utopia and a Koenigsegg Regera — parked on the side of a winding road.

And a few feet away from a silver Lexus LFA stood the OpenAI CEO.

The gathering was unplanned, the TikToker, Miguel Godinez, told Business Insider. He and eight friends had taken their sports cars for a drive through the canyon near Lake Berryessa, just Northeast of Napa, California, when they pulled over at a gas station.

Then, he said, "a bunch of cars I've never seen" joined.

"We talked for a minute, and he was super nice and chill," Godinez, whose channel posts mainly sports car content, said about Altman. "I felt like he was a normal person driving his car just like us, with the same hobbies."
